notes.title: Playdius becomes Dear Villagers, update your bookmarks!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/5616d549bc6367e85662dd1d70eb4c4bb462f87d.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyone,

A few days ago we rebranded Playdius to Dear Villagers, as you can see here in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o__gK6ChBpE]announcement trailer[/url].
Considering we cannot rename this page we kindly invite you to keep following us on the new one: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34635421]Dear Villagers on Steam[/url].

Note that we also just announced two new very exciting games:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/986310/Recompile/][h1][b]Recompile[/b][/h1][/url] Explore the birth of sapient AI in this atmospheric hacking adventure set in the sprawling world of Recompile.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/43b36fe8b6bffa19159e310a4e7348b1a6f72ef1.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037020/ScourgeBringer/][h1][b]ScourgeBringer[/b][/h1][/url] Fast-paced free-moving roguelite platformer. Help Kyhra to explore the unknown and to slash her way through the ancient machines guarding the seal of her past, and maybe the redemption of humanity.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31006285/4c9bb7e439a33240495493367775b090edfec980.gif[/img]

And not forgetting a new major update for the ongoing Early Access of JRPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/269190/Edge_Of_Eternity/][b]Edge Of Eternity![/b][/url]!

Looking forward to fully release these games and unveil even new ones!

The Dear Villagers team

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Bug fixes, nerfs & a better Korean support
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/65cde3588f126dbf57afb61273d33bdff8fd7b11.png[/img]

Hi fellow pixel aficionados!

We're more than happy to see that you are more & more playing OSM & we've started [b]fixing issues[/b] you've told us on social media. But let's get to the point, here's the [b]patchlog[/b] of what changes in this [b]new version[/b]!

- Nerfed visual effects for Outrash Revenge (glitches are not violent anymore)
- Better Korean support (font improved and changes in localization)
- [STEAM] Fixed achievements "All Star Teacher" and "All Star Newbie"
- Various bug fixes

Updates will continue to come, to stay [b]up to date[/b] with the [b]latest news[/b] and [b]updates[/b] regarding [b]Old School Musical[/b], please [b]visit[/b] the [url=https://www.osmgame.com/][b]Official website[/b][/url], [b]like[/b] the official  [url=https://www.facebook.com/oldschoolmusical/][b]Facebook page[/b][/url] and [b]follow[/b] the game on [url=https://twitter.com/osmgame][b]Twitter[/b][/url].

And you can also [b]add[/b] the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] too!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/ae9abddd471fe04507c669938a0046b9527e493a.png[/img]
